reuse.why: The two link rules are shared helpers used by all six link functions, and findOrCreateBank/handleSyncResponse/syncAccount are reused, but the Fintegra linker, downloader and balance branch are copies of sibling providers and the replacement unlink re-writes unlinkAccount's field clearing.

duplication.why: Adds a ~60-line copy of the provider link function, a copy of the download function, a copy of the akahu starting-balance branch, and a copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field list; ensureAccountCanBeLinked also repeats the 'account not found' lookup each link function still does.

placement.why: Guards sit in accounts/app.ts before side effects, the downloader and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts and the URL in server-config.ts, matching where each provider's pieces already live.

scope.why: Focused on the four requested steps; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers is a small adjacent type fix.

maintainability.why: The link rules are defined once, but the provider pattern grows by another full copy and the link-clearing field list now lives in two places that can drift from each other.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts clears the old account's link with its own db.updateAccount instead of unlinkAccount (deliberately, to avoid the provider call, but without extracting the shared local-unlink step)

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (linkFintegraAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions, the fintegra balance branch, the unlink field list) are overt copies of existing code, only lightly compacted.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and an if(!replaceExistingLink) throw / else unlink branch, turning a check into a check-or-mutate helper; all six link functions call both guards.
